; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Ace HUD
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; // Variables
var $navinAlias = "NavInstrument"
var $navinKVP = ""
var $_returnVeloKVP : text
var $_returnXYCordKVP : text
var $prevX = 0
var $prevY = 0
var $prevZ = 0
var $invertX = 1  ; 0 for false, 1 for true
var $invertY = 0  ; 0 for false, 1 for true

; // Main

; Function to convert degrees to radians
function @degToRad($degrees:number) : number
	return $degrees * pi / 180

; Function to linearly interpolate between two values
function @lerp($start:number, $end:number, $t:number,$power:number) : number
	return $start + ($end - $start) * ($t^$power)

; Function to calculate dynamic FOV based on screen dimensions
function @calculateFOV($screen_width:number, $screen_height:number) : number
	var $baseFOV = 30  ; Base FOV for reference screen size
	var $baseWidth = 100  ; Reference screen width
	var $baseHeight = 80  ; Reference screen height

	var $aspectRatio = $screen_width / $screen_height
	var $baseAspectRatio = $baseWidth / $baseHeight

	return $baseFOV * ($aspectRatio / $baseAspectRatio)

; Function to apply perspective projection to a 3D vector
function @perspectiveProjection($x:number, $y:number, $z:number, $fov:number, $aspect:number, $near:number, $far:number) : text
	var $fovRad = @degToRad($fov / 2)
	var $f = 1 / tan($fovRad)
	var $rangeInv = 1 / ($near - $far)

	var $px = $x * $f / $aspect
	var $py = $y * $f
	var $pz = $z * ($far + $near) * $rangeInv + (2 * $far * $near) * $rangeInv
	var $pw = -$z

	if $pw == 0
		$pw = 1

	var $_returnKVP = ""
	$_returnKVP.PX = $px / $pw
	$_returnKVP.PY = $py / $pw
	$_returnKVP.PZ = $pz / $pw
	return $_returnKVP

; Function to map normalized device coordinates (NDC) to screen coordinates
function @ndcToScreen($px:number, $py:number, $screen_width:number, $screen_height:number) : text
	var $_returnKVP = ""
	$_returnKVP.SX = ($px + 1) * $screen_width / 2
	$_returnKVP.SY = ($py + 1) * $screen_height / 2
	return $_returnKVP

; Function to draw a 3D vector on a 2D screen with smooth interpolation
function @drawVector($_screen:screen, $velocityX:number, $velocityY:number, $velocityZ:number, $fov:number, $aspect:number, $near:number, $far:number)
	var $projected = @perspectiveProjection($velocityX, $velocityY, $velocityZ, $fov, $aspect, $near, $far)
	var $px = $projected.PX:number
	var $py = $projected.PY:number

	; Apply inversion flags
	if $invertX == 1
		$px = -$px
	if $invertY == 1
		$py = -$py

	var $screen_width = $_screen.width
	var $screen_height = $_screen.height
	var $screenCoords = @ndcToScreen($px, $py, $screen_width, $screen_height)
	var $sx = $screenCoords.SX
	var $sy = $screenCoords.SY
	


	; Smooth interpolation
	var $steps = 50
	var $power = 1.1
	var $t = 0
	while $t <= 1
		var $interpX = @lerp($prevX, $sx, $t,$power)
		var $interpY = @lerp($prevY, $sy, $t,$power)
		; Draw a circle at the interpolated coordinates
		var $radius = (min($screen_width, $screen_height) / 2) * 0.07
		$_screen.draw_circle($interpX, $interpY, $radius, color(200, 200, 200, 8))




		; Draw the vertical line at the top of the circle
		var $lineTopX1 = $interpX
		var $lineTopY1 = $interpY - $radius
		var $lineTopX2 = $interpX
		var $lineTopY2 = $lineTopY1 - ($radius * 1.2) ; Adjust length as needed
		$_screen.draw_line($lineTopX1, $lineTopY1, $lineTopX2, $lineTopY2, color(200, 200, 200, 255))

		; Draw the horizontal line on the left side of the circle
		var $lineLeftX1 = $interpX - $radius
		var $lineLeftY1 = $interpY
		var $lineLeftX2 = $lineLeftX1 - ($radius * 1.2) ; Adjust length as needed
		var $lineLeftY2 = $interpY
		$_screen.draw_line($lineLeftX1, $lineLeftY1, $lineLeftX2, $lineLeftY2, color(200, 200, 200, 255))

		; Draw the horizontal line on the right side of the circle
		var $lineRightX1 = $interpX + $radius
		var $lineRightY1 = $interpY
		var $lineRightX2 = $lineRightX1 + ($radius * 1.2) ; Adjust length as needed
		var $lineRightY2 = $interpY
		$_screen.draw_line($lineRightX1, $lineRightY1, $lineRightX2, $lineRightY2, color(200, 200, 200, 255))






		$t = $t + (1 / $steps)
	; Update previous coordinates
	$prevX = $sx
	$prevY = $sy

; Function to update the velocity marker based on sensor readings
function @updateVelocityMarker($_screen:screen, $sensorVelocityX:number, $sensorVelocityY:number, $sensorVelocityZ:number, $fov:number, $aspect:number, $near:number, $far:number)
	var $velocityX = -$sensorVelocityX
	var $velocityY = $sensorVelocityY
	var $velocityZ = $sensorVelocityZ

	var $hudPos = @perspectiveProjection($velocityX, $velocityY, $velocityZ, $fov, $aspect, $near, $far)
	if $hudPos.PZ > 0
		@drawVector($_screen, $velocityX, $velocityY, $velocityZ, $fov, $aspect, $near, $far)

; Example usage
function @initializeAndDrawVector($_screen:screen)
	var $sensorVelocityX = input_number("LinearVelocitySensor", 0)  ; Replace with actual sensor input
	var $sensorVelocityY = input_number("LinearVelocitySensor", 1)  ; Replace with actual sensor input
	var $sensorVelocityZ = input_number("LinearVelocitySensor", 2)  ; Replace with actual sensor input
	var $fov = @calculateFOV($_screen.width,$_screen.height)
	var $screen_width = $_screen.width
	var $screen_height = $_screen.height
	var $aspect = $screen_width / $screen_height
	var $near = 0.1
	var $far = 1000000

	@updateVelocityMarker($_screen, $sensorVelocityX, $sensorVelocityY, $sensorVelocityZ, $fov, $aspect, $near, $far)

function @navinDataToKVP()
	$navinKVP.FAS = input_number($navinAlias, 0)  ; 0 Forward Airspeed (m/s)
	$navinKVP.VS = input_number($navinAlias, 1)  ; 1 Vertical Speed (m/s)
	$navinKVP.ALT = input_number($navinAlias, 2)  ; 2 Altitude (meters from sea level)
	$navinKVP.AT = input_number($navinAlias, 3)  ; 3 Above terrain (meters)
	$navinKVP.HP = input_number($navinAlias, 4)  ; 4 Horizon Pitch (-1.0 to +1.0)
	$navinKVP.HR = input_number($navinAlias, 5)  ; 5 Horizon Roll (-1.0 to +1.0)
	$navinKVP.HDG = input_number($navinAlias, 6)  ; 6 Heading (0.0 to 360)
	$navinKVP.CRS = input_number($navinAlias, 7)  ; 7 Course (0.0 to 360)
	$navinKVP.LAT = input_number($navinAlias, 8)  ; 8 Latitude (degrees from -90 to +90)
	$navinKVP.LON = input_number($navinAlias, 9)  ; 9 Longitude (-180 to +180)

	;@latLonToXY($navinKVP.LAT, $navinKVP.LON)

function @dynamicLines($_screen:screen, $_navinKVP:text)
	var $pitch = $_navinKVP.HP * -90  ; Convert the normalized pitch to degrees
	var $roll = $_navinKVP.HR * -90  ; Convert the normalized roll to degrees
	var $centerX = $_screen.width / 2
	var $centerY = $_screen.height / 2
	var $radius = (min($_screen.width, $_screen.height) / 2) * 0.4
	var $yStep = $radius ; Step size for each 30 degrees of pitch

	; Draw the rotated centerline
	var $lineLength = (min($_screen.width, $_screen.height) / 2) * 0.5
	var $angleRad = $roll * pi / 90
	var $xOffset = $lineLength * cos($angleRad)
	var $yOffset = $lineLength * sin($angleRad)
	
	$_screen.draw_line($centerX - $xOffset+1, $centerY + $yOffset, $centerX + $xOffset, $centerY - $yOffset, color(194, 0, 194, 255))

	; Draw pitch ladder lines with rotation
	var $i = -18
	while $i <= 18
		var $lineY = $i * $yStep - $pitch * ($yStep / 5)
		if $lineY > -$radius*2 and $lineY < $radius*2
			var $ladderLength = (min($_screen.width, $_screen.height) / 2) * 0.17
			var $x1 = $centerX - $ladderLength * cos($angleRad) - $lineY * sin($angleRad)
			var $y1 = $centerY + $ladderLength * sin($angleRad) - $lineY * cos($angleRad)
			var $x2 = $centerX + $ladderLength * cos($angleRad) - $lineY * sin($angleRad)
			var $y2 = $centerY - $ladderLength * sin($angleRad) - $lineY * cos($angleRad)
			if $i == 0
				$_screen.draw_line($x1*0.95, $y1, $x2*1.05, $y2, color(255, 35, 0, 255))
			elseif abs($i) == 18
				$_screen.draw_line($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, color(255, 0, 0, 255))
			else
				$_screen.draw_line($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, color(0, 194, 255, 255))
		$i = $i + 1

function @navinData($_screen:screen, $_navinKVP:text)
	var $xChunk = $_screen.width / 10
	var $yChunk = $_screen.height / 10

	;Top HUD Elements
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 1.2, $yChunk * 1.5, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "M/S " & round($_navinKVP.FAS):text)
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 0.62, $yChunk * 1, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "T-Alt " & (round($_navinKVP.AT)):text)
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 6.6, $yChunk * 1.5, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "S-Alt " & round($_navinKVP.ALT):text)
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 5.7, $yChunk * 1, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "VERT SPD " & round($_navinKVP.VS):text)
	;Bottom HUD Elements
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 1.2, $yChunk * 8.1, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "HDG " & round($_navinKVP.HDG):text)
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 1.2, $yChunk * 8.6, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "CRS " & round($_navinKVP.AT):text)
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 7, $yChunk * 8.1, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "LAT " & $_navinKVP.LAT)
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 7, $yChunk * 8.6, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "LNG " & $_navinKVP.LON)
	;Left Hud Elements
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 1.2, $yChunk * 4.8, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "PT " & round($_navinKVP.HP * -90):text)
	;Right Hud Elements
	$_screen.write($xChunk * 7.1, $yChunk * 4.8, color(0, 194, 255, 255), "RL " & (round($_navinKVP.HR * -90)):text)
	@dynamicLines($_screen, $_navinKVP)

function @staticLines($_screen:screen)
	;Dividing the screen into chunks
	var $xChunk = $_screen.width / 10
	var $x = $xChunk * 8

	var $yChunk = $_screen.height / 10
	var $y = $yChunk * 8

	var $x2 = $xChunk * 9
	var $y2 = $yChunk * 5

	$_screen.draw_line($x, $y, $x2, $y2, color(0, 194, 255, 254))
	$y = $yChunk * 2
	$_screen.draw_line($x, $y, $x2, $y2, color(0, 194, 255, 254))
	$x = $xChunk * 2
	$x2 = $xChunk
	$_screen.draw_line($x, $y, $x2, $y2, color(0, 194, 255, 254))
	$y = $yChunk * 8
	$_screen.draw_line($x, $y, $x2, $y2, color(0, 194, 255, 254))

	$_screen.draw_line(0, $y2, $x2, $y2, color(0, 194, 255, 254))
	$x = $xChunk * 9
	$x2 = $xChunk * 10
	$_screen.draw_line($x, $y2, $x2, $y2, color(0, 194, 255, 254))

function @staticCircles($_screen:screen, $x:number, $y:number)
	$_screen.blank(0)
	var $radius = (min($_screen.width, $_screen.height) / 2) * 0.5
	$_screen.draw_circle($x, $y, $radius, color(0, 194, 255, 254))
	@staticLines($_screen)

function @ACEHUD_Draw($_screen:screen)
	@staticCircles($_screen, $_screen.width / 2, $_screen.height / 2)
	@navinDataToKVP()
	@navinData($_screen, $navinKVP)
	@initializeAndDrawVector($_screen)

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Autopilot
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; flight.xc depends on this, ensure this is `include`'d before it.

; // Variables
; PIDs
var $APLevelPitchPID: text
var $APVSPID: text
var $APLevelRollPID: text
	
var $APAltHoldPID: text

var $APSignalYawPID: text
var $APSignalRollPID: text

var $APHeadingHoldYawPID: text

var $APSpeedHoldPID: text

; Values
var $APPitch: number
var $APRoll: number
var $APYaw: number
var $APThrottle: number

; States
storage var $APOn: number
storage var $APModes: text

; Constants
var $AUTOPILOT_TARGET_LEVEL_PITCH = 0.046132 ; radians. how much to pitch up in rad to keep vert speed ~0m/s
var $AUTOPILOT_TARGET_LEVEL_PITCH_ALT = 7 ; meters

; // Enums
var $AP_MODE_ENUM = ".SPEEDHOLD{speedhold}.LEVELPITCH{levelpitch}.LEVELROLL{levelroll}.SIGNAL{signal}.ALTHOLD{althold}.HEADINGHOLD{headinghold}"

; // Main
		
; Toggles autopilot
; $on: Whether or not to turn autopilot on (0 or 1)
function @Autopilot_Toggle($on: number)
	$APOn = $on
	
; Returns if a mode is on
; $mode: The mode to check
function @Autopilot_IsModeOn($mode: text): number
	return $APModes.$mode != "" and ($APModes.$mode: number) == 1

; Sets the provided autopilot mode on/off
; $mode: The mode to set. e.g: `$AP_MODE_ENUM.SIGNAL`
; $on: Whether or not the mode should be enabled
function @Autopilot_SetMode($mode: text, $on: number)
	if $APModes.$mode == $on ; prevent unneeded var updates. modifying storage vars is hard on disk and easily impacts perf
		return

	$APModes.$mode = $on

; Toggles the provided mode. Use `@Autopilot_SetMode()` to set if it should be on/off
; $mode: The mode to set. e.g: `$AP_MODE_ENUM.SIGNAL`
function @Autopilot_ToggleMode($mode: text, $on: number)
	$APModes.$mode = !@Autopilot_IsModeOn($mode)
	
; Returns the needed pitch to keep vertical speed around ~0m/s
function @Autopilot_GetLevelPitch(): number
	var $altitude = @Sensors_GetAltitude() - $AUTOPILOT_TARGET_LEVEL_PITCH_ALT
	var $karmanLine = @Sensors_GetKarmanLineAlt() - $AUTOPILOT_TARGET_LEVEL_PITCH_ALT

	var $ratio = 1 - $altitude / $karmanLine
	return clamp($AUTOPILOT_TARGET_LEVEL_PITCH * $ratio, 0, 1)
	
; Levels off pitch and keeps vert speed low
; $pitch: The current pitch
; $targetVertSpeed: The target vertical speed
; $offset: The angle offset in radians
function @_Autopilot_LevelPitch($pitch: number, $targetVertSpeed: number, $offset: number): number
	; Try to get to target vertical speed
	var $vertSpeedError = @Sensors_GetVerticalSpeed() - $targetVertSpeed
	$APVSPID.@PID_Update($vertSpeedError, 0)

	; Try to get to target pitch (level pitch + vert speed pid output as an angle)
	var $levelPitch = @Autopilot_GetLevelPitch()
	var $multiplier = clamp(abs($vertSpeedError), 0, 0.5)
	$APLevelPitchPID.@PID_Update($pitch, $levelPitch + ($APVSPID.Value * (pi / 180)) * $multiplier + $offset)

	return -$APLevelPitchPID.Value

; Levels off roll
; $roll: The current roll
function @_Autopilot_LevelRoll($roll: number): number
	$APLevelRollPID.@PID_Update($roll, 0)
	return $APLevelRollPID.Value: number * 2

; Inits the autopilot controller. To be called in `init`
function @Autopilot_Init()
	if !$APOn
		@Autopilot_SetMode($AP_MODE_ENUM.SIGNAL)

	$APLevelPitchPID = @PID_New(20, 0, 0.1, -0.5, 0.5, -1, 1)
	$APVSPID = @PID_New(0.3, 0.1, 0.05, -1, 1, -1, 1)
	$APLevelRollPID = @PID_New(0.5, 0, 0.05, -1, 1, -1, 1)
	
	$APAltHoldPID = @PID_New(0.3, 0.1, 0.05, -1, 1, -1, 1)

	$APSignalYawPID = @PID_New(30, 0, 0.4, -1, 1, -1, 1)
	$APSignalRollPID = @PID_New(0.35, 0, 0.2, -1, 1, -1, 1)

	$APHeadingHoldYawPID = @PID_New(0.35, 0.0001, 0.05, -1, 1, -1, 1)
	
	$APSpeedHoldPID = @PID_New(0.3, 0, 0.05, 0, 1, -1, 1)
	
; To be called in `update`
function @Autopilot_Update()
	; Reset values
	$APPitch = 0
	$APRoll = 0
	$APYaw = 0
	$APThrottle = 0

	if !$APOn
		return

	; Sensor inputs
	var $pitch = @Sensors_GetPitch()
	var $roll = @Sensors_GetRoll()

	; Hold speed
	if @Autopilot_IsModeOn($AP_MODE_ENUM.SPEEDHOLD)
		$APSpeedHoldPID.@PID_Update(@Sensors_GetForwardVelocity(), input_number("APTargetSpeed", 0))
		$APThrottle += clamp($APSpeedHoldPID.Value, 0.01, 1) ; clamp to very low value to prevent letting user take control of throttle when at 0

	; Level pitch
	if @Autopilot_IsModeOn($AP_MODE_ENUM.LEVELPITCH)
		$APPitch += @_Autopilot_LevelPitch($pitch, 0, 0)

	; Level roll
	if @Autopilot_IsModeOn($AP_MODE_ENUM.LEVELROLL)
		$APRoll += @_Autopilot_LevelRoll($roll)

	; Hold alt
	if @Autopilot_IsModeOn($AP_MODE_ENUM.ALTHOLD)
		; Level pitch
		@Autopilot_SetMode($AP_MODE_ENUM.LEVELPITCH, 0)
	
		; Up or down?
		var $APAltHoldTarget = input_number("APTargetAlt", 0)
	
		var $altError = $APAltHoldTarget - @Sensors_GetAltitude()
		var $absAltError = abs($altError)
		$APAltHoldPID.@PID_Update($altError, 0)

		; Pitch up/down safely (don't wanna nosedive or stall)
		var $targetPitch = -$APAltHoldPID.Value
		$targetPitch *= pi / 180 ; degrees to radians
		$targetPitch *= lerp(1.5, 10, clamp($absAltError / 400, 0, 1)) ; the further we are from target alt, the more we pitch

		; Pitch
		var $pitchOutput = @_Autopilot_LevelPitch($pitch, clamp($absAltError / 20, -1, 1), $targetPitch)
		$APPitch += $pitchOutput

	; Navigate to signal
	if @Autopilot_IsModeOn($AP_MODE_ENUM.SIGNAL)
		; Get locator data
		var $locatorValues = @Sensors_GetLocatorValues()
	
		; Level off roll if facing target enough, otherwise roll into the turn
		if abs($locatorValues.Yaw) < 0.25
			@Autopilot_SetMode($AP_MODE_ENUM.LEVELROLL, 1)
		else
			$APSignalRollPID.@PID_Update($roll, clamp(-$locatorValues.Yaw * 4, -0.5, 0.5)) ; roll into the turn
			$APRoll += $APSignalRollPID.Value

		; Yaw to target
		$APSignalYawPID.@PID_Update($locatorValues.Yaw, 0)
		$APYaw += $APSignalYawPID.Value

	; Hold heading
	if @Autopilot_IsModeOn($AP_MODE_ENUM.HEADINGHOLD)
		; Yaw to desired heading
		var $APHeadingTarget = input_number("APTargetHeading", 0)
	
		$APHeadingHoldYawPID.@PID_Update(@Sensors_GetHeading() - $APHeadingTarget, 0)
		$APYaw += $APHeadingHoldYawPID.Value
		
	; Clamp
	$APPitch = clamp($APPitch, -1, 1)
	$APRoll = clamp($APRoll, -1, 1)
	$APYaw = clamp($APYaw, -1, 1)
	$APThrottle = clamp($APThrottle, 0, 1)

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Beacon
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; // Main

; Creates a new beacon object
; $alias: The alias for the beacon
function @Beacon_New($alias: text): text
	var $beacon = ""
	$beacon.Alias = $alias
	$beacon.ReceiveFrequency = 0
	$beacon.TransmitFrequency = 0
	$beacon.IncomingData = ""
	$beacon.Distance = 0
	$beacon.DirectionX = 0
	$beacon.DirectionY = 0
	$beacon.DirectionZ = 0
	$beacon.IsReceiving = 0

	return $beacon
	
; Updates a beacon object. This is to be called in `update`
; $self: The beacon object
function @Beacon_Update($self: text): text
	$self.IncomingData = input_text($self.Alias, 0)
	$self.Distance = input_number($self.Alias, 1)
	$self.DirectionX = input_number($self.Alias, 2)
	$self.DirectionY = input_number($self.Alias, 3)
	$self.DirectionZ = input_number($self.Alias, 4)
	$self.IsReceiving = input_number($self.Alias, 5)

	return $self

; Transmit the provided data
; $self: The beacon object
; $data: The data to transmit
function @Beacon_Transmit($self: text, $data: text): text
	output_text($self.Alias, 0, $data)
	return $self

; Set the frequencies for a beacon
; $self: The beacon object
; $transmit: The transmitting frequency
; $receive: The receiving frequency
function @Beacon_SetFrequencies($self: text, $transmit: number, $receive: number): text
	output_number($self.Alias, 1, $transmit)
	$self.TransmitFrequency = $transmit

	output_number($self.Alias, 2, $receive)
	$self.ReceiveFrequency = $receive

	return $self

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Controls
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; big pain in the ass but no one would really use this vehicle if the controls were fucked

; most people use default controls from what i can tell which is like up/down arrows for pitch
; but people don't like that, so they use the vehicle_translate_forward/backward binds for pitch
; in their vehicles instead of changing their controls

; this controller is to adapt to people who adapt their controls and people who adapt their vehicles
; to their desired controls

; // Variables
; Consts
const $CONTROLS_DESCRIPTION = "W/S: Pitch/FwBw || A/D: Roll/LfRi\nLf/Ri Arrows: Yaw || Up/Dw Arrow: Up/Dw"

; Values
storage var $controlProfile: text

; Enums
var $CONTROL_PROFILE_ENUM = ".DEFAULT{default}.ADAPTED{adapted}"

; // Main

; Sets the control profile
; $to: The control profile to set. See `$CONTROL_PROFILE_ENUM`
function @Controls_SetControlProfile($to: text)
	$controlProfile = $to
		
; Returns a description for a control profile
; $profile: The control profile to get a description for. See `$CONTROL_PROFILE_ENUM`
function @Controls_GetProfileDescription($profile: text): text
	if $profile == $CONTROL_PROFILE_ENUM.DEFAULT
		return "Assumes you use the default controls where\nup/down is pitch, etc."
	elseif $profile == $CONTROL_PROFILE_ENUM.ADAPTED
		return "Assumes you changed your controls to get W/S\nfor pitch, etc."
		
; Returns the pitch from a seat
; $seat: The seat object
function @Controls_GetPitch($seat: text): number
	if $controlProfile == $CONTROL_PROFILE_ENUM.DEFAULT
		return $seat.BwFw ; with default controls, this is W/S
		
	if $controlProfile == $CONTROL_PROFILE_ENUM.ADAPTED
		return $seat.Pitch
		
	return $seat.Pitch
	
; Returns the roll from a seat

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Doors
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; Door dashboards must be 300x150cm
; Door screens must be HD and cover the entire dashboard
; Door pivots must have max rotation speed of 0.1, and acceleration of 1. Keep in servo mode.

; // Variables
; Consts
const $DOOR_UI_BG_TILE_SIZE = 25
var $DOOR_UI_BG_TILE_COLOR = color(6, 25, 45, 20)

var $DOOR_UI_BG_COLOR = color(40, 120, 255)

const $DOOR_UI_GRADIENT_HEIGHT = 35
const $DOOR_UI_GRADIENT_STEP = 1
var $DOOR_UI_GRADIENT_COLOR_START = color(80, 210, 255)
var $DOOR_UI_GRADIENT_COLOR_END = color(80, 180, 255, 0)

var $DOOR_UI_BUTTON_BG_COLOR = color(15, 80, 200)
var $DOOR_UI_TEXT_COLOR = color(255, 255, 255)

; Vars
storage var $doors: text ; door_id: door

; Screens
var $doorBGScreen = virtualscreen(300, 150)

; // Main

; Draws the door UI background. To be intended for use on a virtual screen
; $virtualScreen: The virtual screen to draw to
function @_Doors_DrawUIBackground($virtualScreen: screen)
	$virtualScreen.blank($DOOR_UI_BG_COLOR)
	$virtualScreen.@Widgets_FuturisticBackground($DOOR_UI_BG_TILE_SIZE, $DOOR_UI_GRADIENT_STEP, $DOOR_UI_GRADIENT_HEIGHT, $DOOR_UI_GRADIENT_COLOR_START, $DOOR_UI_GRADIENT_COLOR_END, $DOOR_UI_BG_TILE_COLOR)

; Draws the door UI background
; $screen: The door's screen
function @Doors_DrawUIBackground($screen: screen)
	$screen.blank(0)
	screen_copy($doorBGScreen, $screen, 0, 0, 0, 0, $screen.width, $screen.height, -1, 0, 1)

; Draws the main door UI that doesn't change at all
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $door: The door
function @_Doors_DrawUIInit($screen: screen, $door: text)
	; Background
	$screen.@Doors_DrawUIBackground()
	
	; Text
	$screen.text_size(3)
	$screen.@Widgets_HeaderText(5, 30, 0, $DOOR_UI_TEXT_COLOR, $DOOR_UI_TEXT_COLOR, "Door")
	
	; Cosmetic button
	$screen.text_size(5)
	@Widgets_FuturisticButton($screen, 12, 65, $DOOR_UI_BUTTON_BG_COLOR, $DOOR_UI_BUTTON_BG_COLOR, $DOOR_UI_TEXT_COLOR, if(!$door.Open, "Open", "Close"))
	
; Handles UI drawing for a door (init)
; $door: The door
function @_Doors_HandleUIInit($door: text)
	var $count = $door.ScreenCount: number

	for 1, $count ($screenIndex)
		var $screenAlias = @Door_GetScreenAlias($door, $screenIndex)
		var $screen = screen($screenAlias, 0)
		$screen.@_Doors_DrawUIInit($door)
	
; Draws the updating part of the UI for a door
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $door: The door
function @_Doors_DrawUIUpdate($screen: screen, $door: text)	
	if $screen.clicked
		$door.@Door_Refresh()
		$door.@Door_Open(!$door.Open)
		
		var $id = $door.ID
		$doors.$id = $door ; update changes
		
; Handles UI drawing for a door (update)
; $door: The door
function @_Doors_HandleUIUpdate($door: text)
	var $count = $door.ScreenCount: number
	
	if $door.RefreshNeeded
		$door.@Door_CancelRefresh()
		@_Doors_HandleUIInit($door)

	for 1, $count ($screenIndex)
		var $screen = screen(@Door_GetScreenAlias($door, $screenIndex), 0)		
		$screen.@_Doors_DrawUIUpdate($door)

; Registers a door and returns the new door instance
; $id: The door ID
; $screenCount: The amount of screens for the door
; $inverted: Whether or not the door pivot is inverted
function @Doors_Register($id: text, $screenCount: number, $inverted: number): text
	var $door = @Door_New($id, $screenCount, $inverted)
	$doors.$id = $door

	@_Doors_HandleUIInit($door)
	
	return $door

; Opens a door
; $id: The door ID
; $open: Whether or not to open (1) or close (0)
function @Doors_Open($id: text, $open: number)
	if !$doors.$id
		print("Doors: Unrecognized door ID of "  & $id)
		return
		
	var $door = $doors.$id
	$door.@Door_Open($open)

	$doors.$id = $door
	
; Returns if the provided door is open or not
; $id: The ID of the door
function @Doors_IsOpen($id: text): number
	var $door = $doors.$id
	return $door.Open: number
	
; Inits this controller
function @Doors_Init()
	$doorBgScreen.@_Doors_DrawUIBackground()
	
	foreach $doors ($id, $door)
		@_Doors_HandleUIInit($door)

; Update everything (to be called in `update`)
function @Doors_Update()
	foreach $doors ($id, $door)
		; Door UI
		@_Doors_HandleUIUpdate($door)
	
		; Door pivot
		var $angle = 0.25 * $door.Open
		
		if $door.Inverted
			$angle *= -1
		
		output_number($door.PivotAlias, 0, $angle)

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Flight
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; // Variables
; Consts
const $VTOL_FORWARD_SPEED_LIMIT = 75 ; m/s. >40 makes rotation difficult due to heightened drag
const $VTOL_FORWARD_SPEED_LIMIT_OVERDRIVE_MULTIPLIER = 1.4 ; how much to multiply speed limit when `$overdrive` is 1
const $VTOL_ASCENT_RATE = 15 ; m/s ^ 2. dictates how fast the ship goes up in VTOL
const $VTOL_DESCENT_RATE = 15 ; m/s ^ 2. dictates how fast the ship goes down in VTOL
const $VTOL_FLIPOVER_THROTTLE = 1 ; throttle used to flip ship upright when upside down in VTOL
const $VTOL_UP_MULTIPLIER = 6 ; multiplier to vtol hover pid.
const $VTOL_UP_MINIMUM = 0.08 ; minimum vtol hover pid value. gets scaled up/down by the factors below
const $VTOL_UP_MULTI_AT_MASS = 103800 ; the mass used during hover pid tuning in kg
const $VTOL_UP_MULTI_AT_GRAVITY = 0.99 ; the gravity used during hover pid tuning in g (gravity)

const $CRUISE_SPEED_LIMIT = 180 ; m/s. speed limit for 0m alt
const $CRUISE_SPEED_LIMIT_OVERDRIVE_MULTIPLIER = 1.8 ; how much to multiply speed limit when `$overdrive` is 1
const $CRUISE_MAX_SPEED_LIMIT = 650 ; m/s. at max altitude (see const below)
const $CRUISE_MAX_SPEED_LIMIT_ALT = 150000 ; meters. altitude required to reach max speed limit
const $CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE = 2.5 ; the value needed to be passed to thruster pivots to face forward for cruise flight
const $CRUISE_TOWARDS_COURSE_MULTIPLIER = 0.1 ; multiplier for matching heading to course when no, e.g, yaw input, is supplied. higher = faster and stronger, lower = slower and weaker
const $CRUISE_TOWARDS_COURSE_LIMIT = 0.3 ; max yaw to apply for matching heading to course
const $CRUISE_TOWARDS_COURSE_ROLL_THRESHOLD = 0.2 ; to ensure the "cruise towards course" only happens when ship is level and not sideways etc
const $CRUISE_THROTTLE_INCREMENT_BY = 0.1 ; how much to increment/decrement throttle by
const $CRUISE_PITCH_MULTIPLIER = 0.11 ; how much to multiply pitch by in cruise mode
const $CRUISE_ROLL_MULTIPLIER = 2.1 ; how much to multiply roll by in cruise mode
const $CRUISE_YAW_MULTIPLIER = 0.13 ; how much to multiply yaw by in cruise mode
const $CRUISE_OVERYAW_THRESHOLD = 15 	; if course deviation is over this value, cut off yaw
										; this is to prevent overyawing and letting jesus take the wheel
const $CRUISE_OVERYAW_REACTION_YAW = 0.6 ; how much to yaw if we overyaw due to cutoff threshold above and if current user input will fuck it up more
const $CRUISE_STARTING_PITCH_TRIM = 0.12 ; self-explanatory
const $CRUISE_STARTING_ROLL_TRIM = 0 ; self-explanatory
const $CRUISE_STARTING_YAW_TRIM = 0 ; self-explanatory

const $FLIGHT_MODE_TRANSITION_TIME = 5 ; seconds


const $PUMP_POWER = 0.5 ; changing this will require so much tuning of everything else and would fuck shit up
						; future me: do not fucking change this!
						
const $PUMP_POWER_CRUISE_MODE = 0.7

const $INPUT_SMOOTH_OVER_TICKS = 5 ; how many ticks to smooth use flight input over

; Values
storage var $userCruisePitchTrim: number
storage var $userCruiseRollTrim: number
storage var $userCruiseYawTrim: number

var $desiredPitch = 0
array $avgDesiredPitch: number
var $desiredRoll = 0
array $avgDesiredRoll: number
var $desiredYaw = 0
array $avgDesiredYaw: number

var $desiredForward = 0
var $desiredRight = 0
var $desiredUp = 0

storage var $isPrecisionMode: number ; if on, descent rate and ascent rate gets lessened
storage var $isOverdrive: number ; if on, speed limit gets multiplied by `$CRUISE_MAX_SPEED_LIMIT_OVERDRIVE_MULTIPLIER`

storage var $isAnchorsEnabled: number
storage var $isGyrosOn: number
storage var $isThrustersIgnited: number
storage var $isEnginesOn: number

storage var $cruiseThrottle: number
storage var $flightMode: text ; "VTOL", "CRUISE"
storage var $flightModeSetAt: number ; timestamp

; PIDs
var $cruisePitchCorrectionPID: text
var $cruiseRollCorrectionPID: text
var $cruiseYawCorrectionPID: text

var $VTOLPitchCorrectionPID: text
var $VTOLRollCorrectionPID: text
var $VTOLYawCorrectionPID: text

var $VTOLRightCorrectionPID: text
var $VTOLForwardCorrectionPID: text
var $VTOLHoverPID: text
var $VTOLForwardPID: text

; // Enums
var $FLIGHT_MODE_ENUM = ".VTOL{vtol}.CRUISE{cruise}"

; // Main

; Sets the current flight mode
; $mode: The flight mode to set to
function @Flight_SetFlightMode($mode: text)
	if $flightMode == $mode
		return

	$flightMode = $mode
	$flightModeSetAt = time
	
; Gets the current flight mode
function @Flight_GetFlightMode(): text
	return $flightMode
	
; Returns if the flight mode transition was recent
function @Flight_WasFlightModeTransitionRecent(): number
	return time - $flightModeSetAt < $FLIGHT_MODE_TRANSITION_TIME
	
; Returns if the current flight mode is the one provided
; $mode: The flight mode to check against
function @Flight_IsFlightMode($mode: text): number
	return $flightMode == $mode
	
; Returns the speed limit for the current flight mode
function @Flight_GetSpeedLimit(): number
	; Return VTOL speed limit if in VTOL
	if @Flight_IsFlightMode($FLIGHT_MODE_ENUM.VTOL)
		if $isOverdrive
			return $VTOL_FORWARD_SPEED_LIMIT * $VTOL_FORWARD_SPEED_LIMIT_OVERDRIVE_MULTIPLIER
	
		return $VTOL_FORWARD_SPEED_LIMIT
		
	; Return cruise speed limit if in cruise
	if @Flight_IsFlightMode($FLIGHT_MODE_ENUM.CRUISE)
		var $speedLimit = lerp($CRUISE_SPEED_LIMIT, $CRUISE_MAX_SPEED_LIMIT, @Sensors_GetAltitude() / $CRUISE_MAX_SPEED_LIMIT_ALT)
		
		if $isOverdrive
			return $speedLimit * $CRUISE_SPEED_LIMIT_OVERDRIVE_MULTIPLIER
			
		return $speedLimit
		
	; fuck
	return 0
	
; Returns the total fuel
function @Flight_GetTotalFuel(): number
	return input_number("Fuel", 0)
	
; Sets whether or not overdrive is enabled
; $on: Whether or not to enable overdrive
function @Flight_SetOverdrive($on: number)
	$isOverdrive = $on

; Extend/retract landing anchors
; $extend: 1 = extend, 0 = retract
function @Flight_SetAnchors($extend: number)
	$isAnchorsEnabled = $extend
	
; Toggles precision mode
; $on: Whether or not to enable precision mode
function @Flight_SetPrecisionMode($on: number)
	$isPrecisionMode = $on

; Set whether or not engines should be on
; $on: Engines on/off
function @Flight_SetEnginesOn($on: number)
	$isEnginesOn = $on
	
; Toggles the stabilization gyroscopes
; $on: Whether or not to turn the gyros on
function @Flight_SetGyros($on: number)
	$isGyrosOn = $on
	
; Sets thruster ignition
; $on: Whether or not to enable thruster ignition
function @Flight_SetThrusterIgnition($on: number)
	$isThrustersIgnited = $on

; Sets pitch, roll, yaw
; $pitch: -1 to 1
; $roll: -1 to 1
; $yaw: -1 to 1
function @Flight_Rotate($pitch: number, $roll: number, $yaw: number)
	; smooth out inputs
	$avgDesiredPitch.append($pitch)
	
	if $avgDesiredPitch.size > $INPUT_SMOOTH_OVER_TICKS
		$avgDesiredPitch.erase(0)
		
	$avgDesiredRoll.append($roll)
	
	if $avgDesiredRoll.size > $INPUT_SMOOTH_OVER_TICKS
		$avgDesiredRoll.erase(0)
		
	$avgDesiredYaw.append($yaw)
	
	if $avgDesiredYaw.size > $INPUT_SMOOTH_OVER_TICKS
		$avgDesiredYaw.erase(0)
	
	; update values
	$desiredPitch = $avgDesiredPitch.avg
	$desiredRoll = $avgDesiredRoll.avg
	$desiredYaw = $avgDesiredYaw.avg
	
; Sets forward, right, up
; $forward: -1 to 1
; $right: -1 to 1
; $up: -1 to 1
function @Flight_VTOLMove($forward: number, $right: number, $up: number)
	$desiredForward = $forward
	$desiredRight = $right
	$desiredUp = $up
	
; Returns the ship's cruise mode throttle
function @Flight_GetCruiseThrottle(): number
	return if($APOn and $APThrottle != 0, $APThrottle, $cruiseThrottle)
	
; Rotate the ship using the magic cube.
; Very cheaty :-(, but due to the shape of the ship,
; I have to use a magic cube to make cruise mode function good enough.
; I do not fancy redesigning the front of the ship either.
; $pitch: The pitch, -1 to 1
; $roll: The roll, -1 to 1
; $yaw: The yaw, -1 to 1
function @Flight_RotateMagically($pitch: number, $roll: number, $yaw: number)
	output_number("MagicCube", 0, 1)

	output_number("MagicCube", 4, clamp(-$pitch, -1, 1))
	output_number("MagicCube", 6, clamp($roll, -1, 1))
	output_number("MagicCube", 5, clamp(-$yaw, -1, 1))
	
; Rotate a thruster
; $location: The location of the thruster, e.g: "FL" for front left thruster
; $to: The amount to rotate, -1 to 1
function @Flight_RotateThruster($location: text, $to: number)
	output_number("TPivot" & $location, 0, $to / 10)
	
; Sets a thruster's throttle by opening/closing the thruster's valve enough
; $location: The location of the thruster, e.g: "FL" for front left thruster
; $throttle: The throttle, 0 - 1
function @Flight_SetThrusterThrottle($location: text, $throttle: number)
	output_number("TValve" & $location, 0, $throttle * $isEnginesOn)
	
; Sets the throttle while considering $CRUISE_THROTTLE_INCREMENT_BY
; $to: The number to set the throttle to (0 - 1)
function @Flight_SetThrottle($to: number)
	$cruiseThrottle = round(clamp($to, 0, 1) / $CRUISE_THROTTLE_INCREMENT_BY) * $CRUISE_THROTTLE_INCREMENT_BY
	
; Increases/decreases throttle depending on the number given
; $changeBy: -1 = decrease, 1 = increase
function @Flight_ChangeCruiseThrottle($changeBy: number)
	@Flight_SetThrottle($cruiseThrottle + ($CRUISE_THROTTLE_INCREMENT_BY * sign($changeBy)))
	
; Resets pitch trim to default value
function @Flight_ResetPitchTrim()
	$userCruisePitchTrim = $CRUISE_STARTING_PITCH_TRIM
	
; Resets roll trim to default value
function @Flight_ResetRollTrim()
	$userCruiseRollTrim = $CRUISE_STARTING_ROLL_TRIM
	
; Resets yaw trim to default value
function @Flight_ResetYawTrim()
	$userCruiseYawTrim = $CRUISE_STARTING_YAW_TRIM
	
; Returns engine pump power
function @Flight_GetPumpPower(): number
	if !$isEnginesOn
		return 0
	
	if @Flight_IsFlightMode($FLIGHT_MODE_ENUM.VTOL)
		return $PUMP_POWER
	elseif @Flight_IsFlightMode($FLIGHT_MODE_ENUM.CRUISE)
		return $PUMP_POWER_CRUISE_MODE
		
	return 0
	
; Init flight controller
function @Flight_Init()
	; Setup flight mode state
	if $flightMode == ""
		$flightMode = $FLIGHT_MODE_ENUM.VTOL
		
	; Setup initial trim
	if !$userCruisePitchTrim
		@Flight_ResetPitchTrim()
		
	if !$userCruiseRollTrim
		@Flight_ResetRollTrim()
	
	if !$userCruiseYawTrim
		@Flight_ResetYawTrim()

	; Setup PIDs	
	$cruisePitchCorrectionPID = @PID_New(5, 0.01, 0.01, -1, 1, -1, 1)
	$cruiseRollCorrectionPID = @PID_New(0.54, 0, 0.2, -1, 1, -100, 100)
	$cruiseYawCorrectionPID = @PID_New(0.3, 0.0001, 0.1, -1, 1, -100, 100)
	
	$VTOLPitchCorrectionPID = @PID_New(2, 0.001, 0.8, -0.8, 0.8, -100, 100)
	$VTOLRollCorrectionPID = @PID_New(0.2, 0, 0.15, -0.4, 0.4, -100, 100)
	$VTOLYawCorrectionPID = @PID_New(1, 0, 0.2, -0.6, 0.6, -100, 100)
	
	$VTOLRightCorrectionPID = @PID_New(0.4, 0, 0.5, -0.3, 0.3, -100, 100)
	$VTOLForwardCorrectionPID = @PID_New(0.6, 0, 0.1, -0.6, 0.6, -100, 100)
	$VTOLForwardPID = @PID_New(0.3, 0, 0.1, -1, 1, -100, 100)

	$VTOLHoverPID = @PID_New(0.2, 0.00075, 0.05, 0, 1, -100, 100) ; the minimum value is constantly changed. also this is a bitch to tune ill tell you that

; Updates everything flight-related
function @Flight_Update()
	; Pumps
	output_number("TPump*", 0, @Flight_GetPumpPower())
	
	; Ignition
	output_number("Thruster*", 0, $isThrustersIgnited * $isEnginesOn)
	
	; Anchors
	output_number("Anchor*", 0, $isAnchorsEnabled)

	; Gyros
	output_number("Gyro*", 0, $isGyrosOn)

	; Controls
	@Flight_Rotate(-@Controls_GetPitch($pilotSeat), @Controls_GetRoll($pilotSeat), @Controls_GetYaw($pilotSeat))
	@Flight_VTOLMove(@Controls_GetFwBw($pilotSeat), @Controls_GetLfRi($pilotSeat), @Controls_GetUpDown($pilotSeat))
	
	; Check if landed
	if $isAnchorsEnabled and !@Sensors_GetIsActive()
		@Flight_RotateThruster("*", 0)
		@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("*", 0)
		return ; no point in doing any flight computation if we're landed

	; Handle rotation
	var $pitchRate = @Sensors_GetPitchRate()
	var $yawRate = -@Sensors_GetYawRate()
	var $rollRate = @Sensors_GetRollRate()
	
	var $ascentRate = if($isPrecisionMode, $VTOL_ASCENT_RATE / 2, $VTOL_ASCENT_RATE)
	var $descentRate = if($isPrecisionMode, $VTOL_DESCENT_RATE / 5, $VTOL_DESCENT_RATE)
	
	if @Flight_IsFlightMode($FLIGHT_MODE_ENUM.VTOL)
		; we're upside down so fuck everything and focus on flipping over
		; then let all the flight correction code run once we're back up right
		var $horizonValues = @Sensors_GetHorizonValues()
		
		if abs($horizonValues.Roll) >= 0.8
			@Flight_RotateThruster("LF", 0)
			@Flight_RotateThruster("LB", -5)
			@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("LF", $VTOL_FLIPOVER_THROTTLE)
			@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("LB", $VTOL_FLIPOVER_THROTTLE)
			
			@Flight_RotateThruster("RF", 0)
			@Flight_RotateThruster("RB", -5)
			@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("RF", $VTOL_FLIPOVER_THROTTLE)
			@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("RB", $VTOL_FLIPOVER_THROTTLE)

			return
	
		; Hovering
		var $verticalSpeed = @Sensors_GetVerticalSpeed()
		var $hoverError = $verticalSpeed - ($desiredUp * if($desiredUp > 0, $ascentRate, $descentRate))
		$VTOLHoverPID.@PID_Update($hoverError, 0) ; attempts to cancel Y velocity, and fuck gravity

		; Translation PIDs
		$VTOLForwardCorrectionPID.@PID_Update(@Sensors_GetForwardVelocity() / 30, $desiredForward / 5) ; attempts to cancel Z velocity
		$VTOLRightCorrectionPID.@PID_Update(@Sensors_GetRightwardsVelocity() / 30, 0) ; attempts to cancel X velocity
		
		$VTOLForwardPID.@PID_Update(@Sensors_GetForwardVelocity(), @Flight_GetSpeedLimit() * $desiredForward)
		
		; Rotation PIDs
		$VTOLPitchCorrectionPID.@PID_Update(@Sensors_GetPitch() * 2, 0) ; attempts to correct pitch
		$VTOLRollCorrectionPID.@PID_Update(@Sensors_GetRoll() * 2, $desiredRight / 4) ; attempts to correct roll
		$VTOLYawCorrectionPID.@PID_Update($yawRate * 10, 0) ; attempts to correct yaw
		
		; Pitch
		var $VTOLPitch = -$VTOLPitchCorrectionPID.Value
	
		; Roll
		var $VTOLRoll = $VTOLRightCorrectionPID.Value ; user left/right input handled in roll correction PID
		$VTOLRoll += $VTOLRollCorrectionPID.Value * 2
		
		; Yaw
		if $desiredYaw != 0
			$VTOLYawCorrectionPID.Value = 0
			$yawRate = 0
		
		var $VTOLYaw = $VTOLYawCorrectionPID.Value
		$VTOLYaw += $desiredYaw
		$VTOLYaw += -$yawRate * 15

		; Forward
		if $desiredForward != 0
			$VTOLForwardCorrectionPID.Value = 0
	
		var $VTOLForward = $VTOLForwardCorrectionPID.Value
		$VTOLForward += $VTOLForwardPID.Value
		
		; Hovering
		var $massRatio = @Sensors_GetMass() / $VTOL_UP_MULTI_AT_MASS
		var $gravityRatio = @Sensors_GetGravity() / $VTOL_UP_MULTI_AT_GRAVITY
		var $finalRatio = $massRatio * $gravityRatio
		
		$VTOLHoverPID.Minimum = $VTOL_UP_MINIMUM * $finalRatio ; larger minimum for smoother hover. helps hide the oscillations

		var $VTOLUP = $VTOLHoverPID.Value: number
		$VTOLUP *= $VTOL_UP_MULTIPLIER
		$VTOLUP *= $finalRatio
		$VTOLUP = clamp($VTOLUP, 0, 1)
		
		; Thrust vectoring
		; LEFT SIDE: +1 = points forward
		; RIGHT SIDE: +1 = points backwards (inverts needed)
		@Flight_RotateThruster("LF", ($VTOLForward + $VTOLYaw) / 2)
		@Flight_RotateThruster("LB", ($VTOLForward + $VTOLYaw) / 2)

		@Flight_RotateThruster("RF", (-$VTOLForward + $VTOLYaw) / 2)
		@Flight_RotateThruster("RB", (-$VTOLForward + $VTOLYaw) / 2)
		
		; Throttle
		@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("LF", clamp($VTOLUP + $VTOLRoll + -$VTOLPitch, 0.01, 1))
		@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("LB", clamp($VTOLUP + $VTOLRoll + $VTOLPitch, 0.01, 1))

		@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("RF", clamp($VTOLUP + -$VTOLRoll + -$VTOLPitch, 0.01, 1))
		@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("RB", clamp($VTOLUP + -$VTOLRoll + $VTOLPitch, 0.01, 1))
	elseif @Flight_IsFlightMode($FLIGHT_MODE_ENUM.CRUISE)
		; Get true desired pitch, roll and yaw
		var $sysPitch = if($isPrecisionMode, $desiredPitch / 10, $desiredPitch) + $APPitch
		$sysPitch *= $CRUISE_PITCH_MULTIPLIER

		var $sysRoll = if($isPrecisionMode, $desiredRoll / 10, $desiredRoll) + $APRoll
		$sysRoll *= $CRUISE_ROLL_MULTIPLIER

		var $sysYaw = if($isPrecisionMode, $desiredYaw / 6, $desiredYaw) + $APYaw
		$sysYaw *= $CRUISE_YAW_MULTIPLIER
		
		; Enforce speed limit, but kinda smoothly to prevent sudden engine throttle jumps
		var $forwardVelocity = @Sensors_GetForwardVelocity()
		var $throttleMultiplier = 1

		var $startSmoothOutSpeed = @Flight_GetSpeedLimit() * 0.97

		if $forwardVelocity > $startSmoothOutSpeed
			$throttleMultiplier = 1 - ($forwardVelocity - $startSmoothOutSpeed) / (@Flight_GetSpeedLimit() - $startSmoothOutSpeed)
	
		; PIDs + User/AP Input
		$cruisePitchCorrectionPID.@PID_Update($pitchRate, $sysPitch)
		$cruiseRollCorrectionPID.@PID_Update($rollRate, $sysRoll)
		$cruiseYawCorrectionPID.@PID_Update($yawRate, $sysYaw)
		
		; Pitch
		var $pitchTrimMultiplier = $userCruisePitchTrim / $CRUISE_SPEED_LIMIT
		var $pitchTrim = $forwardVelocity * $pitchTrimMultiplier
		
		var $cruisePitch = $sysPitch
		$cruisePitch += -$pitchRate * 40
		$cruisePitch += $cruisePitchCorrectionPID.Value * 4
		$cruisePitch += $pitchTrim
	
		; Roll
		var $cruiseRoll = $sysRoll
		$cruiseRoll += -$rollRate * 60
		$cruiseRoll += $cruiseRollCorrectionPID.Value * 4
		$cruiseRoll += $userCruiseRollTrim 
	
		; Yaw
		var $cruiseYaw = $sysYaw
		
		$cruiseYaw += -$yawRate * 30
		$cruiseYaw += $cruiseYawCorrectionPID.Value * 10
		
		var $roll = @Sensors_GetRoll()
		
		if abs($roll) < $CRUISE_TOWARDS_COURSE_ROLL_THRESHOLD
			var $courseDeviation = @Sensors_GetHeading() - @Sensors_GetCourse()
		
			if $courseDeviation > $CRUISE_OVERYAW_THRESHOLD ; if we're going too far right,
				$cruiseYaw = if($cruiseYaw < 0, $cruiseYaw, -$CRUISE_OVERYAW_REACTION_YAW) ; then only allow yawing to the left
				
			if $courseDeviation < -$CRUISE_OVERYAW_THRESHOLD ; if we're going too far left,
				$cruiseYaw = if($cruiseYaw > 0, $cruiseYaw, $CRUISE_OVERYAW_REACTION_YAW) ; then only allow yawing to the right
		
			if $sysYaw == 0 and !@Flight_WasFlightModeTransitionRecent() ; if we went from vtol to cruise, course is likely not in an ideal position yet
				; match heading to course to prevent yaw-drift or drag fucking the user over
				var $correction = -$courseDeviation * $CRUISE_TOWARDS_COURSE_MULTIPLIER
				$cruiseYaw += clamp($correction, -$CRUISE_TOWARDS_COURSE_LIMIT, $CRUISE_TOWARDS_COURSE_LIMIT)
		
		$cruiseYaw += $userCruiseYawTrim

		; Thrust vectoring
		; LEFT SIDE: +1 = points forward
		; RIGHT SIDE: +1 = points backwards (inverts needed)
		@Flight_RotateThruster("LF", clamp($CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE + (-$cruiseRoll + $cruisePitch) / 2, $CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE - 1, $CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE + 1))
		@Flight_RotateThruster("LB", clamp($CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE + (-$cruisePitch + -$cruiseRoll) / 2, $CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE - 1, $CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE + 1))
		
		@Flight_RotateThruster("RF", clamp(-$CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE + (-$cruiseRoll + -$cruisePitch) / 2, -$CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE - 1, -$CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE + 1))
		@Flight_RotateThruster("RB", clamp(-$CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE + ($cruisePitch + -$cruiseRoll) / 2, -$CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE - 1, -$CRUISE_PIVOT_ANGLE + 1))
		
		; Rotate magically
		; sorry. cheaty i know. but the aerodynamic shape of this ship is awful and it is really hard to overcome drag hence why we rotate magically a lil
		; i could change up the shape, but i'd have to redo plenty of wires and it'd be painful
		if $isEnginesOn and abs($forwardVelocity) > 5 ; pretend it's thrust vectoring or something
			@Flight_RotateMagically($cruisePitch, $cruiseRoll, $cruiseYaw)
		
		; Ailerons
		output_number("LeftYawTop", 0, $cruiseYaw)
		output_number("LeftYawBottom", 0, $cruiseYaw)

		output_number("RightYawTop", 0, $cruiseYaw)
		output_number("RightYawBottom", 0, $cruiseYaw)
		
		; Throttle
		@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("L*", (clamp(($cruiseYaw / 4), 0, 1) + @Flight_GetCruiseThrottle()) * $throttleMultiplier)
		@Flight_SetThrusterThrottle("R*",( clamp((-$cruiseYaw / 4), 0, 1) + @Flight_GetCruiseThrottle()) * $throttleMultiplier)

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Serenity EXP
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; Welcome to the code of the Serenity spaceship (EXP = exploration).
; The code is split into libraries (libs) and controllers, with everything else being
; in this file.
;
; Controllers are responsible for running their own code and handling their own set
; of tasks. They also provide functions for other areas to use (eg: UI controller using
; other controller functions to determine the state of something).
; `flight.xc` is a controller that handles everything flight-related like thrust vectoring,
; throttle control, flight stability, VTOL, etc.
;
; Libraries on the other hand purely provide functions. They don't run code on their own,
; but just make life easier and helps prevent code being repeated as well as making stuff
; cleaner.
;
; Every function, including their arguments, are documented so you can see what is going on
; without having to read the function code.
;
; Variable names should also explain the variable enough. In cases they aren't, they usually
; have a comment describing it. Immutable variables (constants) are written in uppercase in
; snake case, eg: "SOME_CONSTANT".

; For optimizing, aim for <16% perf cost on cuhHub Sandbox server.

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- PID
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; // Main

; Creates a new PID object
; $P: The proportional
; $I: The integral
; $D: The derivative
; $min: The minimum the output can be
; $max: The maximum the output can be
; $iMin: The minimum the integral can be
; $iMax: The maximum the integral can be
function @PID_New($P: number, $I: number, $D: number, $min: number, $max: number, $iMin: number, $iMax: number): text
	var $PID = ""
	$PID.P = $P
	$PID.I = $I
	$PID.D = $D
	$PID.LastTime = 0
	$PID.Integral = 0
	$PID.LastError = 0
	$PID.Value = 0
	$PID.Minimum = $min
	$PID.Maximum = $max
	$PID.MinimumIntegral = $iMin
	$PID.MaximumIntegral = $iMax

	return $PID
	
; Updates a PID object
; $self: The PID object
; $processVariable: The value to push to $setPoint
; $setPoint: The value to push $processVariable towards
function @PID_Update($self: text, $processVariable: number, $setPoint: number): text
	var $error = $setPoint - $processVariable
	var $now = time
	
	if $self.LastTime == $now
		$self.LastTime = time
	
	var $deltaTime = ($now - $self.LastTime)
	$self.LastTime = $now

	var $deltaError = $error - $self.LastError
	$self.LastError = $error
	
	$self.Integral = clamp($self.Integral + ($error * $deltaTime), $self.MinimumIntegral, $self.MaximumIntegral)
	var $derivative = $deltaError / $deltaTime
	
	$self.Value = clamp(($self.P * $error) + ($self.I * $self.Integral) + ($self.D * $derivative), $self.Minimum, $self.Maximum)
	
	; Return
	return $self

; // Variables
; Consts
const $SENSORS_GRAVITY_DETERMINATION_INTERVAL = 1 ; seconds
const $SENSORS_MEASURE_GRAVITY_OVER = 5 ; ticks

; Values
storage var $gravity: number
array $_avgGravity: number
var $_avgGravityCounter: number
var $_gravityLastUpdated: number

; // Main

; Returns the vehicle's forward velocity
function @Sensors_GetForwardVelocity(): number
	return input_number("LinearVelocitySensor", 2)

; Returns the vehicle's rightwards velocity
function @Sensors_GetRightwardsVelocity(): number
	return -input_number("LinearVelocitySensor", 0)
	
; Returns the vehicle's upwards velocity. Best to use @Sensors_GetVerticalSpeed()
function @Sensors_GetUpwardsVelocity(): number
	return input_number("LinearVelocitySensor", 1)

; Returns the vehicle's pitch rate
function @Sensors_GetPitchRate(): number
	return input_number("AngularVelocitySensor", 0)
	
; Returns the vehicle's yaw rate
function @Sensors_GetYawRate(): number
	return input_number("AngularVelocitySensor", 1)
	
; Returns the vehicle's roll rate
function @Sensors_GetRollRate(): number
	return input_number("AngularVelocitySensor", 2)
	
; Returns the vehicle's vertical speed
function @Sensors_GetVerticalSpeed(): number
	return $shipNavInstrument.VerticalSpeed: number

; Returns the vehicle's G forces
function @Sensors_GetGForces(): text
	var $return = ""
	$return.X = input_number("VehiclePhysicsSensor", 8)
	$return.Y = input_number("VehiclePhysicsSensor", 9)
	$return.Z = input_number("VehiclePhysicsSensor", 10)

	return $return

; Resets internal gravity data
function @_Sensors_ResetGravityData()
	$_avgGravityCounter = 0
	$_avgGravity.clear()

; Updates the gravity value
function @_Sensors_DetermineGravity()
	; Not enough time has passed to consider updating the gravity value
	if $_gravityLastUpdated != 0 and time - $_gravityLastUpdated < $SENSORS_GRAVITY_DETERMINATION_INTERVAL
		@_Sensors_ResetGravityData()
		return
		
	; We are moving up or down too much, so gravity reading would be inaccurate
	; and we should therefore not measure right now
	if abs(@Sensors_GetVerticalSpeed()) > 0.01
		return
		
	; Update gravity value to average gravity
	if $_avgGravityCounter >= $SENSORS_MEASURE_GRAVITY_OVER
		$gravity = $_avgGravity.avg
		$_gravityLastUpdated = time
	
		@_Sensors_ResetGravityData()

		return

	; Update last updated and the counter
	$_avgGravityCounter++
	
	; Add gravity to average gravity array. Gravity will get finally calculated after enough ticks
	var $gForces = @Sensors_GetGForces()
	var $gForceY = -$gForces.Y
	$_avgGravity.append($gForceY)
	
; Returns the ship's gravity
function @Sensors_GetGravity(): number
	return if($gravity == 0, 1, $gravity)

	return $shipNavInstrument.Celestial

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Stalker
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; Dependencies: vehicle/signature.xc

; Example
; var $stalker: text
; 
; init
; 	$stalker = @Stalker_New("Stalker", 8, 10000)
; 
; update
; 	$stalker.@Stalker_Stalk(1)
; 	$stalker.@Stalker_Update()
; 	
; timer interval 1
; 	var $targets = $stalker.Targets
; 
; 	foreach $targets($index, $target)
; 		print("---", text("[{00000}] {0.0}m away, found {0.0}s ago", $target.Frequency, $target.Distance, time - $target.FoundAt))

; // Main

; Creates a new target object representing a target found via a stalker
; $frequency: The frequency of the target
; $data: The data received from beacon
; $directionX: The direction X
; $directionY: The direction Y
; $directionZ: The direction Z
; $distance: The distance of the target
; $foundAt: The timestamp the target was found
function @Target_New($frequency: number, $data: text, $directionX: number, $directionY: number, $directionZ: number, $distance: number, $foundAt: number): text
	var $target = ""
	$target.Frequency = $frequency
	$target.DirectionX = $directionX
	$target.DirectionY = $directionY
	$target.DirectionZ = $directionZ
	$target.Distance = $distance
	$target.FoundAt = $foundAt
	$target.HasSignature = @Signature_IsSignature($data)
	
	if $target.HasSignature
		$target.Name = $data.Name
		$target.Type = $data.Type
	
	return $target

; Creates a new stalker object for scanning for any in-use beacon frequencies
; $aliasPrefix: The prefix of the beacons to use for frequency scanning
; $beaconCount: The amount of beacons to use for frequency scanning
; $upTo: The frequency to stalk up to (recommended: 10000)
function @Stalker_New($aliasPrefix: text, $beaconCount: number, $upTo: number): text
	var $stalker = ""
	$stalker.AliasPrefix = $aliasPrefix
	$stalker.BeaconCount = $beaconCount
	$stalker.FrequencyChunkSize = $upTo / $beaconCount
	$stalker.At = 0
	$stalker.UpTo = $upTo
	$stalker.Stalking = 0
	$stalker.TargetCount = 0
	$stalker.Targets = ""
	
	return $stalker
	
; Set whether or not to stalk
; $self: The stalker object
; $stalk: Whether or not to stalk
function @Stalker_Stalk($self: text, $stalk: number): text
	$self.Stalking = $stalk
	return $self
	
; Get target index via frequency
; $frequency: The frequency
function @Stalker_GetIndexViaFreq($frequency: number): text
	return "Freq" & $frequency:text
	
; Update this stalker object (scanning, etc)
; $self: The stalker object
function @Stalker_Update($self: text): text
	if !$self.Stalking
		return $self
		
	; Set targets as var
	var $targets = $self.Targets
		
	; Iterate through beacons
	var $beaconCount = $self.BeaconCount:number

	repeat $beaconCount($beaconIndex)
		; Get frequency for beacon the next tick
		var $nextFrequency = ($self.FrequencyChunkSize * $beaconIndex) + $self.At
		
		; Get frequency of current tick so we can read beacon properly
		var $previousFrequency = $nextFrequency - 1
		
		; Get alias of beacon
		var $alias = $self.AliasPrefix & $beaconIndex:text
		
		; Get index for later
		var $targetIndex = @Stalker_GetIndexViaFreq($previousFrequency)

		; Check for signal
		if $previousFrequency != -1
			if input_number($alias, 5)
				; Read beacon
				var $data = input_text($alias, 0)
				var $directionX = text("{0.00}", input_number($alias, 2)): number ; round to save chars, but precision is still needed so don't round much
				var $directionY = text("{0.00}", input_number($alias, 3)): number ; round to save chars, but precision is still needed so don't round much
				var $directionZ = text("{0.00}", input_number($alias, 4)): number ; round to save chars, but precision is still needed so don't round much
				var $distance = text("{0.0}", input_number($alias, 1)): number ; round to save chars
				var $foundAt = round(time) ; round to save chars
				
				; Create target
				var $target = @Target_New($previousFrequency, $data, $directionX, $directionY, $directionZ, $distance, $foundAt) ; subtract 1 from frequency due to beacon tick update delay

				; Save target
				if !$targets.$targetIndex
					$self.TargetCount ++

				$targets.$targetIndex = $target
			else
				; Check if we saved the target, if so, remove
				if $targets.$targetIndex
					$targets.$targetIndex = ""
					$self.TargetCount--
		
		; Set frequency for next tick
		output_number($alias, 2, $nextFrequency)
		
		; Hide beacon
		output_text($alias, 1, "")
		
	; Increment frequency
	$self.At++

	if $self.At > $self.FrequencyChunkSize
		$self.At = 0
		
	; Update targets
	$self.Targets = $targets
	
	; Return
	return $self

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Text
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; // Main

; Returns whether or not a text starts with the provided prefix
; $text: The text to check
; $prefix: The prefix to check with
function @Text_StartsWith($text: text, $prefix: text): number
	return substring($text, 0, size($prefix)) == $prefix
	
; Returns whether or not a text ends with the provided suffix
; $text: The text to check
; $suffix: The suffix to check with
function @Text_EndsWith($text: text, $suffix: text): number
	return substring($text, size($text) - size($suffix), size($text)) == $suffix
	
; Counts the number of times `$target` is in `$text`
; $text: The text to check
; $target: The text to search and count in $text
function @Text_Count($text: text, $target: text): number
	var $targetLength = size($target)
	var $textLength = size($text)
	var $count = 0
	
	for 0, $textLength($i)
		var $str = substring($text, $i, $targetLength)
	
		if $str == $target
			$count++
			
	return $count
	
; Built-in substring(), but takes a start and an end argument instead of a start and a length
; and also returns the result.
; $text: The text to check
; $start: The start index (0 = first character)
; $end: The end index
function @Text_Substring($text: text, $start: number, $end: number): text
	return substring($text, $start, $end - $start + 1)
	
; Truncates text and adds something on the end to imply it has been truncated (e.g: "...")
; $text: The text to truncate
; $limit: The character limit (the length of $ending is subtracted from this)
; $ending: The suffix to add if the limit is reached and the text is truncated
function @Text_Truncate($text: text, $limit: number, $ending: text): text
	var $trueLimit = $limit - size($ending)

	if size($text) > $trueLimit
		return substring($text, 0, $trueLimit) & $ending
		
	return $text

	$turret.AzimuthPID = @PID_New(0.2, 0, 0.05, -1, 1)
	$turret.InvertAzimuth = $invertAzimuth
	$turret.InvertRestingAzimuth = $invertRestingAzimuth
	$turret.AzimuthRestingAngle = $restingAzimuthAngle

	$turret.ElevationAlias = $aliasPrefix & "_Elevation"
	$turret.ElevationPID = @PID_New(0.2, 0, 0.05, -1, 1)
	$turret.InvertElevation = $invertElevation
	$turret.InvertRestingElevation = $invertRestingElevation
	$turret.ElevationRestingAngle = $restingElevationAngle
	$turret.ElevLimitTop = 0.8 ; todo
	$turret.ElevLimitBottom = 0.04 ; todo
	
	$turret.RadarAlias = $aliasPrefix & "_Radar" ; actually a beacon
	
	$turret.NavInstrument = @NavInstrument_New($aliasPrefix & "_Nav")

	$turret.Enabled = 0
	$turret.Fire = 0
	$turret.Resting = 0
	$turret.TargetFreq = -1
	
	return $turret
	
; Toggle a turret
; $self: The turret to toggle on/off
; $on: Whether or not to turn the turret on
function @Turret_Toggle($self: text, $on: number): text
	$self.Enabled = $on
	return $self
	
; Make a turret fire
; $self: The turret object
; $fire: Whether or not to fire
function @Turret_Fire($self: text, $fire: number): text
	$self.Fire = $fire and !$self.Resting and $self.Enabled
	return $self
	
; Get the elevation of a turret
; $self: The turret object
function @Turret_GetElevation($self: text): number
	return input_number($self.ElevationAlias, 0)

; Get the azimuth of a turret
; $self: The turret object
function @Turret_GetAzimuth($self: text): number
	return input_number($self.AzimuthAlias, 0)

; Rotates the turret by however much provided
; $self: The turret object
; $azimuth: The amount to yaw
; $elevation: The amount to pitch
function @Turret_Rotate($self: text, $azimuth: number, $elevation: number): text
	output_number($self.AzimuthAlias, 0, if($self.InvertAzimuth, -$azimuth, $azimuth))
	output_number($self.ElevationAlias, 0, if($self.InvertElevation, -$elevation, $elevation))
	
	return $self

; Runs the elev PID and returns the value
; $self: The turret object
; $processVariable: The value to process
; $setPoint: The point to aim for
function @Turret_RunElevPID($self: text, $processVariable: number, $setPoint: number): number
	var $elevPID = $self.ElevationPID
	$elevPID.@PID_Update($processVariable, $setPoint)
	$self.ElevationPID = $elevPID
	
	return $elevPID.Value / 5
	
; Runs the azi PID and returns the value
; $self: The turret object
; $processVariable: The value to process
; $setPoint: The point to aim for
function @Turret_RunAziPID($self: text, $processVariable: number, $setPoint: number): number
	var $aziPID = $self.AzimuthPID
	$aziPID.@PID_Update($processVariable, $setPoint)
	$self.AzimuthPID = $aziPID
	
	return $aziPID.Value / 5

; Run a PID to reset turret elevation
; $self: The turret object
function @Turret_ElevationResetPID($self: text): number
	var $error = $self.ElevationRestingAngle - @Turret_GetElevation($self)
	var $value = @Turret_RunElevPID($self, $error, 0) * clamp(abs($error) * 200, 2, 500)
	
	if $self.InvertRestingElevation
		$value = -$value
	
	return $value

; Run a PID to reset turret azimuth
; $self: The turret object
function @Turret_AzimuthResetPID($self: text): number
	var $error = $self.AzimuthRestingAngle - @Turret_GetAzimuth($self)
	var $value = @Turret_RunAziPID($self, $error, 0) * clamp(abs($error) * 200, 2, 500)
	
	if $self.InvertRestingAzimuth
		$value = -$value
	
	return $value

; Sets the turret's target
; $self: The turret object
; $targetFreq: The target's beacon frequency
function @Turret_SetTarget($self: text, $targetFreq: number): text
	$self.TargetFreq = $targetFreq
	return $self

; Make a turret rest
; $self: The turret object
; $rest: Whether or not to rest
function @Turret_Rest($self: text, $rest: number): text
	$self.Resting = $rest or !$self.Enabled
	return $self
	
; Manage resting
; $self: The turret object
function @Turret_ManageResting($self: text): text
	if !$self.Resting
		return $self

	$self.@Turret_Rotate(@Turret_AzimuthResetPID($self), @Turret_ElevationResetPID($self))
	$self.@Turret_Fire(0)

	return $self
	
; Manage aiming at targets
; $self: The turret object
function @Turret_ManageAiming($self: text): text
	; Check if we're even getting a signal
	if !input_number($self.RadarAlias, 5)
		return $self
		
	; Check if turret is enabled
	if !$self.Enabled
		return $self

	; Calculate azimuth
	var $nav = $self.NavInstrument
	var $azimuth = @Turret_RunAziPID($self, -$nav.LocatorYaw, 0) * clamp(abs($nav.LocatorYaw) * 100, 100, 1000)

	; Calculate elevation
	var $elevation = @Turret_RunAziPID($self, $nav.LocatorPitch, 0) * clamp(abs($nav.LocatorPitch) * 100, 100, 1000)
	
	; Aim
	$self.@Turret_Rest(0)
	$self.@Turret_Rotate($azimuth, $elevation)
	
	; Fire
	if abs($nav.LocatorYaw) < 0.1 and abs($nav.LocatorPitch) < 0.1
		$self.@Turret_Fire(1)
	
	; Return
	return $self
	
; Update a turret (aims the turret, etc)
; $self: The turret object
function @Turret_Update($self: text): text
	; Update nav instrument
	var $nav = $self.NavInstrument
	$nav.@NavInstrument_Update()
	$nav.@NavInstrument_SetLocate("", input_number($self.RadarAlias, 1), input_number($self.RadarAlias, 2), input_number($self.RadarAlias, 3), input_number($self.RadarAlias, 4))

	$self.NavInstrument = $nav
	
	; Update beacon freq
	output_number($self.RadarAlias, 2, $self.TargetFreq:number)

	; Check if we're getting a signal
	if !input_number($self.RadarAlias, 5)
		$self.@Turret_Rest(1)

	; Check if turret is enabled
	if !$self.Enabled
		$self.@Turret_Rest(1)
	
	; Manage resting/aiming
	$self.@Turret_ManageResting()
	$self.@Turret_ManageAiming()

	; Return
	return $self

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- Turrets
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; // Variables
; Consts
const $TURRET_COUNT = 1

; Values
storage var $isTurretsOn: number
storage var $canTurretsFire: number

; Turrets
array $turrets: text

; // Main

; Enables/disables turrets
; $on: Whether or not to enable turrets
function @Turrets_Toggle($on: number)
	$isTurretsOn = $on
	
; Dictates whether or not the turrets can shoot
; $canShoot: 0 = can't shoot, 1 = can shoot
function @Turrets_ToggleShooting($canShoot: number)
	$canTurretsFire = $canShoot

; Inits this controller
function @Turrets_Init()
	for 1, $TURRET_COUNT ($i)
		var $turret = @Turret_New("Turret" & $i:text, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0)
		$turrets.append($turret)

; Updates this controller
function @Turrets_Update()
	foreach $turrets ($index, $turret)
		; Turret toggling
		if $turret.Enabled: number != $isTurretsOn
			$turret.@Turret_Toggle($isTurretsOn)
			
		; Turret target frequency
		if $turret.TargetFreq: number != $receiveFreq
			$turret.@Turret_SetTarget($receiveFreq)
			
		; Update turret
		$turret.@Turret_Update()
		
		; Turret "shooting"
		output_number("Turret" & ($index + 1):text & "_Spotlight", 0, $turret.Fire and $canTurretsFire)
		
		; Update changes
		$turrets.$index = $turret

; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
; // ------- UI
; // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

; Guide for future me, or anyone who decides to edit this:
; - Minimize UI draw calls! Use virtualscreen() for complex draws (like the background).
; - Text that isn't updated can be thrown in `@_UI_MFDInit()`
; - For any text that changes when a button is pressed, draw the text in `@_UI_MFDInit()` instead and simply call `@UI_MFDRefresh()` for
; 	the MFD when the button is pressed to redraw the text. This is far better than drawing the text every tick or every x ticks.
; - Any parts of a menu that has constantly changing text should be drawn in `_@UI_MFDDeferredUpdate()` as said in the first point.
; Optimization is very important here! The UI is quite possibly the biggest bottleneck on this ship for performance.

; // Variables
; Consts
var $MFD_BG_COLOR = color(40, 120, 255)
var $MFD_BG_GRADIENT_COLOR_START = color(80, 210, 255)
var $MFD_BG_GRADIENT_COLOR_END = color(80, 180, 255, 0)
const $MFD_BG_GRADIENT_HEIGHT = 27
const $MFD_BG_GRADIENT_STEP = 1
var $MFD_BG_TILE_COLOR = color(6, 25, 45, 20)
const $MFD_BG_TILE_SIZE = 90

var $MFD_TEXT_COLOR = color(255, 255, 255)
var $MFD_TEXT_GOOD_COLOR = color(125, 255, 125)
var $MFD_TEXT_BAD_COLOR = color(255, 125, 125)
var $MFD_TEXT_BG_COLOR = color(6, 17, 25)

var $MFD_BUTTON_TEXT_COLOR = color(255, 255, 255)
var $MFD_BUTTON_BG_COLOR = color(15, 80, 200)
var $MFD_BUTTON_BG_COLOR_SECONDARY = color(25, 75, 245)

var $MFD_STATUS_BG_COLOR = color(8, 8, 8)
var $MFD_STATUS_OFF_COLOR = color(255, 80, 15)
var $MFD_STATUS_ON_COLOR = color(80, 255, 15)

var $MFD_SLIDER_BG_COLOR = color(15, 80, 200)
var $MFD_SLIDER_PROGRESS_COLOR = color(25, 125, 255)
var $MFD_SLIDER_TEXT_COLOR = color(255, 255, 255)
var $MFD_SLIDER_BUTTON_COLOR = color(25, 75, 180)

var $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_BG_COLOR = color(15, 90, 230)
var $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_SELF_BG_COLOR = color(15, 140, 240)
var $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_SCROLL_BG_COLOR = color(15, 80, 200)
var $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_SIZE = 80
var $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_PADDING = 3

const $MFD_UPDATE_EVERY = 10 ; ticks. updates non-interactive ui elements every $MFD_UPDATE_EVERY ticks
const $ACE_HUD_UPDATE_EVERY = 2 ; ticks

; Screens
var $MFDBGScreen = virtualscreen(300, 210)

; Data
var $MFDTick = 0
storage var $MFDs: text

; // Enums
var $MFD_MENU_ENUM = ".NONE{none}.COMBAT{combat}.CONTROLS{controls}.STALKER{stalker}.TRIM{trim}.FLIGHT{flight}.REFUELING{refueling}.STATS{stats}.COMMUNICATIONS{communications}.NAVIGATION{navigation}.POWER{power}.MISC{misc}.AUTOPILOT{autopilot}"

; // Main

; Returns if the current menu for a MFD is the one provided
; $MFD: The MFD data
; $menu: The menu to check for
function @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD: text, $menu: text): number
	return $MFD.Menu == $menu

; Creates template MFD menu data
; $ID: The ID of the MFD
function @_UI_TemplateMFDData($ID: text): text
	var $MFDData = ""
	$MFDData.StalkerScroll = 0
	$MFDData.Menu = $MFD_MENU_ENUM.NONE
	$MFDData.ID = $ID
	
	return $MFDData
	
; Updates an MFD property
; $MFD: The MFD
; $property: The property name
; $value: The new value
function @_UI_MFDSet($MFD: text, $property: text, $value: text): text
	$MFD.$property = $value

	var $ID = $MFD.ID
	$MFDs.$ID = $MFD
	
	return $MFD
	
; Updates an MFD property (number shortcut)
; $MFD: The MFD
; $property: The property name
; $value: The new value that is a number
function @_UI_MFDSetNumber($MFD: text, $property: text, $value: number): text
	return @_UI_MFDSet($MFD, $property, $value: text)

; Returns whether or not it has been $MFD_UPDATE_EVERY ticks
; Used to prevent updating an MFD every tick for optimization
function @_UI_HasBeenTicks(): number
	return $MFDTick % $MFD_UPDATE_EVERY == 0 or $MFDTick == 1 ; last statement is for instant draw on boot

; Changes a value by amount depending on slider state
; $value: The value to change
; $sliderValue: The data returned by slider widget draw (-1, 0, or 1)
; $amount: The amount to change by
; $min: The minimum value
; $max: The maximum value
function @_UI_ChangeValueBySlider($value: number, $sliderValue: number, $amount: number, $min: number, $max: number): number
	return clamp($value + ($sliderValue * $amount), $min, $max)

; Draw MFD rect status
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $x: The X coord
; $y: The Y coord
; $width: The width
; $height: The height
; $status: The status
function @UI_MFDRectStatus($screen: screen, $x: number, $y: number, $width: number, $height: number, $status: number)
	$screen.@Widgets_RectStatus($x, $y, $width, $height, $MFD_STATUS_BG_COLOR, $MFD_STATUS_OFF_COLOR, $MFD_STATUS_ON_COLOR, $status)

; Draw a futuristic MFD button
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $x: The X coord
; $y: The Y coord
; $text: The text to display
; $withStatus: Displays a RectStatus widget before the button. Use -1 to hide. 0 or 1 for status.
function @UI_MFDButton($screen: screen, $x: number, $y: number, $text: text, $withStatus: number): number
	var $pressed = @Widgets_FuturisticButton($screen, $x, $y, $MFD_BUTTON_BG_COLOR, $MFD_BUTTON_BG_COLOR_SECONDARY, $MFD_BUTTON_TEXT_COLOR, $text)

	if $withStatus != -1
		$screen.@UI_MFDRectStatus($x - 25, $y, $screen.char_h, $screen.char_h, $withStatus)
		
	return $pressed

; Draw MFD header text
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $x: The X coord
; $y: The Y coord
; $text: The text to display
; $textColor: The color of the text
function @UI_MFDHeaderText($screen: screen, $x: number, $y: number, $text: text, $textColor: number)
	$screen.@Widgets_HeaderText($x, $y, $MFD_TEXT_BG_COLOR, $textColor, $textColor, $text)
	
; Draws a slider for an MFD
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $x: The X coord
; $y: The Y coord
; $width: The slider width
; $height: The slider height
; $label: The slider label
; $value: The value, 0 - 1
function @UI_MFDSlider($screen: screen, $x: number, $y: number, $width: number, $height: number, $label: text, $value: number): number
	return @Widgets_Slider($screen, $x, $y, $width, $height, $label, $MFD_SLIDER_BG_COLOR, $MFD_SLIDER_PROGRESS_COLOR, $MFD_SLIDER_BUTTON_COLOR, $MFD_SLIDER_TEXT_COLOR, $value)
	
; Writes battery status. Used in power MFD menu. Note that this sets the screen's text size to `2`
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $x: The X coord
; $y: The Y coord
; $data: The battery data
function @UI_MFDBatteryStatus($screen: screen, $x: number, $y: number, $data: text)
	$screen.text_size(2)
	$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText($x, $y, text("{0.0}%", $data.Charge * 100), if($data.Charge > 0.3, $MFD_TEXT_GOOD_COLOR, $MFD_TEXT_BAD_COLOR))
	$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText($x + ($screen.char_w * 8), $y, text("{0.0}W", $data.Throughputs), if($data.Throughputs > 0, $MFD_TEXT_GOOD_COLOR, $MFD_TEXT_BAD_COLOR))

; Draws the MFD UI background. Intended for virtual screens
; $virtualScreen: The virtual screen to draw to
function @_UI_MFDBackground($virtualScreen: screen)
	; Blank
	$virtualScreen.blank($MFD_BG_COLOR)

	; Draw background tiles
	$virtualScreen.@Widgets_FuturisticBackground($MFD_BG_TILE_SIZE, $MFD_BG_GRADIENT_STEP, $MFD_BG_GRADIENT_HEIGHT, $MFD_BG_GRADIENT_COLOR_START, $MFD_BG_GRADIENT_COLOR_END, $MFD_BG_TILE_COLOR)

; Draws the MFD UI background
; $screen: The screen to draw to
function @UI_MFDBackground($screen: screen)
	$screen.blank(0)
	screen_copy($MFDBGScreen, $screen, 0, 0, 0, 0, $screen.width, $screen.height, -1, 0, 1)

; Renders an MFD (init). To be called by @UI_MFD()
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $MFD: The MFD data
; $resetTick: Whether or not to reset MFD ticks
function @_UI_MFDInit($screen: screen, $MFD: text, $resetTick: number)
	; Background
	$screen.@UI_MFDBackground()
	
	; Screen ID or menu name
	$screen.text_size(2)

	if @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.NONE)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 5, $MFD.ID, $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	else
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 5, upper($MFD.Menu), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		
	; Menus
	if @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.FLIGHT)
		$screen.text_size(1)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 125, "Flight Mode", $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)	
	elseif @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.COMBAT)
		$screen.text_size(1)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(60, 90, "Target = Comms Receive Frequency\nTurrets cannot cause damage.", $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	elseif @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.CONTROLS)
		; Control profile name
		$screen.text_size(2)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 30, upper($controlProfile), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		
		; Control profile description
		$screen.text_size(1)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 50, @Controls_GetProfileDescription($controlProfile), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		
		; Control profile general description
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 50 + ($screen.char_h * 2) + 5, $CONTROLS_DESCRIPTION, $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	elseif @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.TRIM)
		$screen.text_size(2)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 30, "Cruise Mode", $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		
		$screen.text_size(1)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 145, "Far Left = -1, Far Right = 1\nApplies to autopilot.\nEnsure trim is accurate.", $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		
	; Reset tick to trigger an MFD update
	if $resetTick
		$MFDTick = -1 ; -1, not 0. an update would occur the next tick, so if we set this to -1, it'll be 0 the next tick which is what we need
	
; Sets the MFD menu and updates display
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $MFD: The MFD
; $to: The MFD menu to set to
function @UI_MFDSetMenu($screen: screen, $MFD: text, $to: text)
	$MFD.@_UI_MFDSet("Menu", $to)
	$screen.@_UI_MFDInit($MFD, 1)
	
; Refreshes the MFD. Calls `@_UI_MFDInit()`
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $MFD: The MFD data
function @UI_MFDRefresh($screen: screen, $MFD: text)
	$screen.@_UI_MFDInit($MFD, 0)
	
; Renders an MFD (deferred update)
; $screen: The screen to draw on
; $MFD: The MFD data
function @_UI_MFDDeferredUpdate($screen: screen, $MFD: text)
	if !@_UI_HasBeenTicks()
		return
		
	$screen.@UI_MFDRefresh($MFD)
		
	if @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.FLIGHT)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(70, $screen.height - 13, text("Speed Limit: {0.0}m/s", @Flight_GetSpeedLimit()), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	elseif @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.COMMUNICATIONS)
		; Signal stats
		$screen.text_size(2)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 30, "Receiving Signal: " & if($shipBeacon.IsReceiving:number, "Yes", "No"), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		
		; Signature
		var $incomingData = $shipBeacon.IncomingData
		var $isSignalSignature = @Signature_IsSignature($incomingData) and $shipBeacon.IsReceiving
		
		if $shipBeacon.IsReceiving
			$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(30, 50, if($isSignalSignature, "Signature Detected", "No Signature"), if($isSignalSignature, $MFD_TEXT_GOOD_COLOR, $MFD_TEXT_BAD_COLOR))
			$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(30, 70, text("{0.0}km away", $shipBeacon.Distance / 1000), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		else
			$screen.text_size(4)
			$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 55, "No Data", $MFD_TEXT_BAD_COLOR)
		
		if $isSignalSignature
			$screen.text_size(2)

			$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(30, 90, @Text_Truncate($incomingData.Name, 20, "..."), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
			$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(30, 110, "Type: " & @Text_Truncate($incomingData.Type, 15, "..."), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	elseif @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.STATS)
		; Set text size
		$screen.text_size(2)

		; Stats
		var $totalFuel = @Flight_GetTotalFuel()
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 27, text("Fuel: {0.0}%", $totalFuel * 100), if($totalFuel < 0.2, $MFD_TEXT_BAD_COLOR, $MFD_TEXT_GOOD_COLOR))

		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 47, text("Celestial: {}", upper(@Sensors_GetCelestial())), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	
		var $location = @Sensors_GetLocation()
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 67, text("Loc: {0.000}, {0.000}", $location.Lat, $location.Long), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 87, text("Altitude: {0.0}km", @Sensors_GetAltitude() / 1000), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 107, text("Speed: {0.0}m/s", @Sensors_GetSpeedRelCelestial()), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 127, text("Mass: {0.0}kg", @Sensors_GetMass()), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 147, text("State: {}", if(@Sensors_GetIsActive(), "Moving", "Landed")), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	elseif @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.REFUELING)
		$screen.@UI_MFDRefresh($MFD)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 60, text("Flow Rate: {0.0}kg/s", @Refueling_GetFlowRate()), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
	elseif @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.POWER)
		; Low Voltage
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 30, "Low Voltage", $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		$screen.@UI_MFDBatteryStatus(20, 55, @Power_GetLVData())

		; High Voltage
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(5, 80, "High Voltage", $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
		$screen.@UI_MFDBatteryStatus(20, 105, @Power_GetHVData())
	elseif @UI_IsOnMenu($MFD, $MFD_MENU_ENUM.STALKER)
		; Refresh
		$screen.@UI_MFDRefresh($MFD)
			
		; Show progress
		$screen.text_size(2)
		$screen.@UI_MFDHeaderText(10, $screen.height - 57, text("{0}%", ($shipStalker.At / $shipStalker.FrequencyChunkSize) * 100), $MFD_TEXT_COLOR)
			
		; Display targets
		var $totalTargetWidth = $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_SIZE + $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_PADDING
		var $targetBorderPadding = 10
		var $targetX = $targetBorderPadding - $MFD.StalkerScroll
		var $targetY = 60
		var $targets = $shipStalker.Targets
		
		$screen.draw_rect(0, $targetY - 3, $screen.width, $targetY + $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_SIZE + 3, 0, $MFD_STALKER_TARGET_SCROLL_BG_COLOR)

; $screen: The screen to draw on

; $textColor: The text color to use

function @Widgets_FuturisticButton($screen: screen, $x: number, $y: number, $backgroundColor: number, $cornerColor: number, $textColor: number, $text: text): number
	var $textWidth = size($text) * $screen.char_w
	
	; Background
	var $pressed = $screen.button_rect($x - 1, $y - 1, $x + $textWidth + 1, $y + $screen.char_h + 1, 0, $backgroundColor)
	
	; Top left corner
	var $cornerLineHeight = 3
	var $cornerLineWidth = 35
	var $topLeftCornerX = $x - $cornerLineHeight - 2
	var $topLeftCornerY = $y - $cornerLineHeight - 2
	$screen.draw_rect($topLeftCornerX, $topLeftCornerY, $topLeftCornerX + $cornerLineWidth, $topLeftCornerY + $cornerLineHeight, 0, $cornerColor)
	$screen.draw_rect($topLeftCornerX, $topLeftCornerY + $cornerLineHeight, $topLeftCornerX + $cornerLineHeight, $topLeftCornerY + $cornerLineWidth / 3, 0, $cornerColor)
	
	; Bottom right corner
	var $bottomRightCornerX = $x + $textWidth + $cornerLineHeight + 2
	var $bottomRightCornerY = $y + $screen.char_h + $cornerLineHeight + 2
	$screen.draw_rect($bottomRightCornerX, $bottomRightCornerY, $bottomRightCornerX - $cornerLineWidth, $bottomRightCornerY - $cornerLineHeight, 0, $cornerColor)
	$screen.draw_rect($bottomRightCornerX, $bottomRightCornerY - $cornerLineHeight, $bottomRightCornerX - $cornerLineHeight, $bottomRightCornerY - $cornerLineWidth / 3, 0, $cornerColor)
